grammar.pattern: 比较 / 更加 / 还 / 相当：程度
grammar.purpose: Distinguish an explicit comparison from a degree modifier
grammar.explanation: 比较清楚 may mean relatively clear without naming a comparator; 比昨天清楚 is explicit. 更加清楚 builds on a prior degree. 还 can mean even more in 他比我还快, distinct from continuing 还在练. 相当难 means quite difficult here, not a claim two objects are equivalent. Use context, and do not infer a numeric gain.

examples.py: zhè yī duàn bǐ jiào róng yì .
zhè cì gèng jiā qīng chǔ .
examples.en: This time it is even clearer.

examples.zh: 他比我还快，但我还在练。
examples.py: tā bǐ wǒ hái kuài , dàn wǒ hái zài liàn .
examples.en: He is even faster than me, but I am still practising.

commonMistakes.wrong: 比较清楚就是一定比所有人清楚。
commonMistakes.right: 比较清楚不一定说了比较对象。
commonMistakes.why: A relative degree word does not identify every comparator.

grammar.pattern: A比B说得清楚 / A不比B快 / 比B多读一遍
grammar.explanation: 她比我说得清楚 and 她说得比我清楚 compare manner. A不比B快 denies A being faster, allowing equality or slower, rather than proving B is strictly faster. 我比她多读一遍 states one extra repetition; 我比她早到十分钟 states a time difference. 不如 often implies inferiority and differs from 不比. Preserve the dimension and stated amount.

examples.py: tā shuō dé bǐ wǒ qīng chǔ .
examples.en: She speaks more clearly than I do.

examples.zh: 我不比她快，可能一样快。
examples.py: wǒ bù bǐ tā kuài , kě néng yī yàng kuài .
examples.en: I am not faster than her; we may be equally fast.

examples.py: wǒ bǐ tā duō dú yī biàn .
examples.en: I read it one more time than she did.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不比她快，所以她一定更快。
commonMistakes.right: 我不比她快，可能一样快，也可能更慢。
commonMistakes.why: Negating faster allows equality; it does not force strict reversal.

dialogue.title: Clarity before speed
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find which dimension the practice comparison actually measures.

lines.zh: 你这一段比较清楚，比昨天怎么样？
lines.py: nǐ zhè yī duàn bǐ jiào qīng chǔ , bǐ zuó tiān zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: This passage is relatively clear; how does it compare with yesterday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 今天说得比昨天清楚，但不比你快。
lines.py: jīn tiān shuō dé bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ , dàn bù bǐ nǐ kuài .
lines.en: Today I speak more clearly than yesterday, but not faster than you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不比我快，就是一定比我慢吗？
lines.py: bù bǐ wǒ kuài , jiù shì yí dìng bǐ wǒ màn ma ?
lines.en: Not faster than me means certainly slower than me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，可能一样快。速度没有具体记录。
lines.py: bù shì , kě néng yī yàng kuài . sù dù méi yǒu jù tǐ jì lù .
lines.en: No, possibly equally fast. There is no actual speed record.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你读了几遍？
lines.py: nǐ dú le jǐ biàn ?
lines.en: How many times did you read it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三遍，你两遍，我比你多读一遍。
lines.py: sān biàn , nǐ liǎng biàn , wǒ bǐ nǐ duō dú yī biàn .
lines.en: Three; you read twice, so I read once more.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天先练清楚，演唱时再有舞台的感觉。
lines.py: jīn tiān xiān liàn qīng chǔ , yǎn chàng shí zài yǒu wǔ tái de gǎn jué .
lines.en: Practise clarity first today; add stage energy when singing.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，强调意思，不乱改声调。
lines.py: hǎo , qiáng diào yì si , bù luàn gǎi shēng diào .
lines.en: Okay, emphasize meaning without arbitrarily changing tones.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: How many extra readings did the speaker do?
Does not faster prove strictly slower?

reading.title: A karaoke practice note
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read an original spoken note rather than infer tone accuracy from a song.

lines.zh: 今天练原创短句，先说清楚，再演唱。
lines.py: jīn tiān liàn yuán chuàng duǎn jù , xiān shuō qīng chǔ , zài yǎn chàng .
lines.en: Today practise original short lines: speak clearly before singing.

lines.zh: 三遍比两遍多一遍，只说次数，不说谁更有才能。
lines.py: sān biàn bǐ liǎng biàn duō yī biàn , zhǐ shuō cì shù , bù shuō shéi gèng yǒu cái néng .
lines.en: Three repetitions is one more than two; that compares counts, not talent.

lines.zh: 说得比昨天清楚是进步方向，没有准确分数。
lines.py: shuō dé bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ shì jìn bù fāng xiàng , méi yǒu zhǔn què fēn shù .
lines.en: Clearer speech than yesterday indicates a direction of progress, not an exact score.

lines.zh: 不比朋友快可以一样快，不能自动写成更慢。
lines.py: bù bǐ péng you kuài kě yǐ yī yàng kuài , bù néng zì dòng xiě chéng gèng màn .
lines.en: Not faster than a friend may be equally fast; do not automatically report slower.

lines.zh: 艺术表演会改变声音，学习声调要听清楚的说话。
lines.py: yì shù biǎo yǎn huì gǎi biàn shēng yīn , xué xí shēng diào yào tīng qīng chǔ de shuō huà .
lines.en: Artistic performance may alter the voice; learn tones from clear speech.

lines.zh: 舞台也能演话剧，不是所有演员都是歌手。
lines.py: wǔ tái yě néng yǎn huà jù , bù shì suǒ yǒu yǎn yuán dōu shì gē shǒu .
lines.en: A stage can host spoken drama too; not every performer is a singer.

lines.zh: 技术可以进一步改进，乐队没来时也先读文字。
lines.py: jì shù kě yǐ jìn yí bù gǎi jìn , yuè duì méi lái shí yě xiān dú wén zì .

lines.zh: 演出精彩不等于任务全完成，记录要具体。
lines.py: yǎn chū jīng cǎi bù děng yú rèn wù quán wán chéng , jì lù yào jù tǐ .
lines.en: An excellent performance does not finish every task; keep records specific.
